_note: Public TOON devnet endpoints. As of 2026-07-19 the devnet settles on PUBLIC chains (Base Sepolia, public Solana devnet) — the self-hosted Linode chain boxes (evm-rpc/solana-rpc/solana-ws/mina.<DOMAIN>) are DELETED, and Mina itself left the repository with ADR 0065. Peers point a TOON node/SDK at these URLs (chainRpcUrls / EVM_RPC_URL). Faucet (2-chain web UI): https://faucet.devnet.toonprotocol.dev

evm._fund: curl -X POST https://faucet.devnet.toonprotocol.dev/api/base-sepolia/request -d '{"address":"0x…"}' → mints 1000 USDC. The devnet USDC is Circle's FiatToken v2.2 (ERC-3009 + EIP-2612, the code Base mainnet USDC runs), deployed 2026-09-25 (#1337); its mint(address,uint256) is MINTER-GATED and the faucet key is the minter, so fund through the faucet. Per-address 24h cooldown. Basescan: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0x0C996d7c934c79a6255254875607Fe69df25C0E1
evm._tokenNetworkNote: DERIVED, not independent: tokenNetworkUsdc is whatever registryAddress.getTokenNetwork(tokenAddress) answers on chain, so the two move TOGETHER or this file is lying. The 2026-08-06 ERC-2771 cutover (#695/#811, docs/evm-deployment.md) repointed registryAddress here and left tokenNetworkUsdc on the retired 2026-07-18 contract 0x1E95493f… for three weeks; the connector never noticed because it is configured with the REGISTRY ([settlement.evm] contract_address) and resolves the TokenNetwork at boot, so only a direct reader of this key was pointed at a dead contract. Both moved again on 2026-08-28 with the ADR 0059 cutover, and tokenNetworkUsdc and tokenAddress together on 2026-09-25 with the FiatToken cutover (#1337, docs/evm-deployment.md). Re-derive it with: cast call --rpc-url https://base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com 0x0c41D9D424d6B075A3cEa1068a694f7847a8CCa5 "getTokenNetwork(address)(address)" 0x0C996d7c934c79a6255254875607Fe69df25C0E1
evm._chainNote: PUBLIC Base Sepolia testnet (chainId 84532) — no self-hosted node. The anvil chain evm:31337 (token 0x5FbDB2…, registry 0xe7f1725E…) is deleted.

solana._fund: https://faucet.devnet.toonprotocol.dev (web UI) or POST /api/solana/usdc-request → drips USDC on the PUBLIC Solana devnet (USDC only since connector#898 — the SOL leg is retired; get SOL from https://faucet.solana.com)
solana._chainNote: PUBLIC Solana devnet — the self-hosted test validator (mint H8HSreUF…) is deleted.

baseSepolia._note: Mirror of the evm block — since the 2026-07-19 cutover the devnet's EVM chain IS Base Sepolia. Kept for consumers that read this key. Every address here MUST equal the evm block's, tokenNetworkUsdc included: see that block's _tokenNetworkNote, and note that the miss it records was a miss in BOTH copies at once — a mirror check would not have caught it, which is why crates/connector-bin/tests/devnet_configs_load.rs pins both copies to FLEET_LIVE_REGISTRY and FLEET_LIVE_TOKEN_NETWORK rather than to each other.

_decimalsNote: USDC is 6-decimal on every chain, so claim base units are uniform — no cross-chain normalization needed.
